propositions: Comment sync identifies comments by body equality, causing collisions and false duplicates when bodies match or are edited; identity must be a persistent HLC-timestamp to Jira-comment-ID map instead.

Returned Jira comment IDs from add_comment API calls are currently discarded; they must be captured at both create_one and update_one enactment sites and persisted via record_comment_id with write-ahead save.

Outbound comment bodies are not rendered through RichTextCodec.to_wire, and the _resolve_codec seam uses _IdentityCodec instead of the real codec, breaking dedup-key convergence after the DC comment-diff migration.

Cloud add_comment must ADF-encode bodies via json.dumps(to_wire(fitted)) with fit-before-encode ordering, but currently sends plaintext unencoded; the plaintext sanitization guard must not run on serialized JSON.

Comment sync is not append-only; edits and deletes can re-sync if body or ID tracking is lost, requiring strict directional authority (inbound-origin jira_comment_id, outbound-origin map) with demoted body-equality as secondary skip.
